notes.title: 5.22 Update Notes
notes.content:
I noticed that some players reset the game every time they fail because there is no text guidance, so I removed the reset game button on the failure screen to avoid the frustration of repeatedly touching the same crystal, so that you can focus more on finding the path to touch the next crystal.

I also hope that this change will make the "20 minutes" achievement easier to complete.
(This achievement is designed to comfort players who can't complete the level. If it is still difficult to complete, I will consider shortening the time limit)

Now, if you need to reset the level to challenge the leaderboard, use the "esc" button to call up the pause interface, where you can reset the level.

I want to improve so much, please be bold to criticize, suggest and guide my game! Thank you very much!
